conditioning: Actual accepted preceding BF16 arrays, not an independently evolved full-prefix or model trajectory.
wave_norm: Unchanged P218 width4096 dual-BF16 norm interval: depth71,8255 half-subnormal allowances,epsilon bits897988541,reviewed sqrt <=1 F32 ULP,correctly rounded F32 divide,32 first-narrow candidates maximum.
qkv: Unchanged P218 BF16 GEMV envelope at K4096/depth71;3072 packed output rows in Q2048,K512,V512 order. Actual accepted normalized input conditions this check.

serial_headnorm.exact_reference: Integer BF16 units2^-133;sum of128 squared integers scaled2^-266,without a floating reduction.
serial_headnorm.derivation: At most one rounded product and128 sequential rounded additions on a contribution path. Count128 products+128 additions for underflow. gamma129 and256*2^-150/(1-129*2^-24) outward enclose source sum;no fitted relative tolerance.
serial_headnorm.divide: Correctly rounded binary32 RNE;no approximate reciprocal substitution.
serial_headnorm.candidate_cap: Refuse uncertainty,never enlarge the cap after reading outputs.
serial_headnorm.correlation: Per-coordinate candidates overapproximate shared inverse correlation;pair membership is necessary conditional consistency,not a joint existence proof.

rope: Authenticated supplied FP32 rotary words;split-half lane,lane+64;separate FP32 ac,bs,bc,as products and first=ac-bs,second=bc+as additions,then BF16 RNE. Enumerate bounded headnorm candidate pairs and require the joint observed pair. No contraction or trig-error allowance is added.
value_append: Exact current-slot BF16 V slice from actual accepted packed QKV;does not independently validate prior KV history.
nonfinite: Refuse nonfinite inputs,accepted intermediates,output words and overflowing interval endpoints.
